cohort: 76,847 newborns, including 3,042 with LBW, 2,941 with MAC, and 70,864 with normal weight
finding: Several neonatal and maternal-related variables, such as cesarean section, pregnancy complications, and hospitalization >7 days, were associated with the odds of LBW and MAC, while factors such as pregnancy with a scarred uterus were related to a decrease in ABW.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased incidence of both LBW and MAC.
